generator?

questions.questionText:
The diagram shows a ray of light in an optical fibre.
Which statement correctly explains the condition for the maximum transmission of light by the
optical fibre?

options.text: The glass must slow the light as little as possible to make the critical angle for the fibre as large as possible.
The glass must slow the light as little as possible to make the critical angle for the fibre as small as possible.
The glass must slow the light as much as possible to make the critical angle for the fibre as large as possible.
The glass must slow the light as much as possible to make the critical angle for the fibre as small as possible.

When a conductor in a complete circuit cuts across a magnetic field, a current is induced in the
conductor.
Which statement about the induced current is correct?

options.text: The induced current is in the same direction as the motion of the conductor.
The induced current is in the opposite direction to the motion of the conductor.

The direction of the induced current opposes the change causing it.

A scientist fires alpha-particles at a very thin sheet of gold and detects the particles that pass
through.
